instruction: A folded paper kitsune standing alert, its body built from sharp creased planes of vermilion paper with crisp white undersides where the sheet flips. Nine separate tails fan upward behind it, each a narrow tapered fold tipped in white, and the pointed muzzle and triangular ears show visible valley and mountain crease lines. The paper has a faint fibrous washi texture and holds hard-edged shadows at every fold.
